title: Bangla titles now make a web address
problem: A Bangla title gave an empty web address.
now: Bangla is written in Latin letters by default, or kept as Bangla if the shop prefers.
steps: Add a page titled মোবাইল কভার.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
